tooltip_definitions.Diagnostics Segment: Clinical next-generation sequencing (NGS), somatic oncology profiling, hereditary germline testing, and liquid biopsy assays ($303.5M in Q3 2026, up +20.0% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Data and Applications: High-margin pharmaceutical multimodal data licensing, algorithm co-development, and clinical trial matching software ($108.1M in Q3 2026, up +33.0% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Minimal Residual Disease (MRD): Ultra-sensitive personalized circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) blood test monitoring post-treatment molecular recurrence (~12,000 tests in Q3, up +300% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Adjusted EBITDA: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, excluding stock-based compensation and transaction costs ($25.57M in Q3 2026, surging +1,633% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Oncology Clinical Volume: Volume of somatic tissue and liquid sequencing tests ordered by oncologists across Tempus' network of connected healthcare systems (+32% unit growth).
tooltip_definitions.Merck & Moderna Collaboration: Multi-year strategic alliance supporting commercialization and patient identification for individualized neoantigen therapy (INT) cancer vaccines.
tooltip_definitions.BMS Strategic Agreement: Major data licensing and translational research expansion announced in October 2026, bringing YTD cumulative data bookings above $550M.
tooltip_definitions.Total Net Revenue: Consolidated net sales across Diagnostics and Data & Applications ($411.54M in Q3 2026, beating $409.30M Street consensus by +$2.24M / +0.55%).
tooltip_definitions.Non-GAAP Diluted EPS: Adjusted net income per share excluding stock-based compensation and non-operating fair value adjustments ($0.07 vs -$0.08 Street consensus, +$0.15 beat).
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Net Loss: Net loss attributable to common stockholders under U.S. GAAP (-$14.85M in Q3 2026, improved by +81.4% YoY from -$79.98M).
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Cash used in operating activities (-$71.59M in Q3 2026, demonstrating improved working capital efficiency vs -$119.84M YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Cash reinvested in high-throughput sequencing instrumentation, lab automation, and proprietary data infrastructure ($23.66M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditures (-$95.25M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Forensic cash generation deducting $154.90M in non-cash stock compensation expense (-$250.15M institutional economic balance).
tooltip_definitions.Full-Year Guidance Raise: Upward revision of FY2026 revenue guidance to $1.60B-$1.605B (~25% annual growth) and reaffirmation of full-year ~$65M Adjusted EBITDA.
tooltip_definitions.Options Volatility Regime: Weekly ATM straddle priced a ±12.40% move ($9.05); stock moved -0.74% after-hours ($77.90), producing sharp volatility crush.
tooltip_definitions.Enterprise Value to Sales: Valuation multiple comparing enterprise value ($14.79B) against forward annualized sales run-rate (~9.2x EV/Sales).
tooltip_definitions.Liquid Biopsy ctDNA: Non-invasive genomic sequencing of cell-free circulating tumor DNA from peripheral blood samples, accelerating targeted therapy selection.
